scripts.build: export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$PATH" && rm -rf OpenGM.Wasm/bin/Release/net10.0/publish && dotnet publish OpenGM.Wasm/OpenGM.Wasm.csproj -c Release && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r OpenGM.Wasm/bin/Release/net10.0/publish/wwwroot/. dist/ && cp host/plugin.js dist/host.js && node scripts/write-manifest.mjs
scripts.format: export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$PATH" && dotnet restore OpenGM.Wasm/OpenGM.Wasm.csproj -p:NuGetAudit=false && dotnet format whitespace OpenGM.Wasm/OpenGM.Wasm.csproj --no-restore && dotnet format style OpenGM.Wasm/OpenGM.Wasm.csproj --no-restore
scripts.format:check: export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$PATH" && dotnet restore OpenGM.Wasm/OpenGM.Wasm.csproj -p:NuGetAudit=false && dotnet format whitespace OpenGM.Wasm/OpenGM.Wasm.csproj --no-restore --verify-no-changes && dotnet format style OpenGM.Wasm/OpenGM.Wasm.csproj --no-restore --verify-no-changes
scripts.test: export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$PATH" && dotnet test OpenGM.Tests/OpenGM.Tests.csproj -p:NuGetAudit=false && node --test scripts/next-version.test.mjs scripts/publish-feed.test.mjs scripts/prune-old-versions.test.mjs
scripts.package: rm -rf plugin && mkdir plugin && cp -R dist/. plugin/ && find plugin \( -name '*.br' -o -name '*.gz' \) -delete
